consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM asks the yes/no 'has the player accounted for item_count of type->item_id within crafting reach?' and that boolean drives the 'objective met' indicator.
scope: items reachable for crafting (carried plus reachable nearby resources via crafting_inventory()), not on-person-only and not raw world state
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — computes a boolean by calling u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback), so the authority is the engine-returned predicate value, not a re-tally of a partial inventory view.
divergence: Required parts lie on a reachable adjacent tile (within crafting reach) but are not in the character's carried inventory: an on-person possession check or a raw carried-items display would report 'not met' while the true MGOAL_FIND_ITEM predicate over crafting_inventory() returns 'met' — exposing a wrong-reach or display-proxy answer.
